fact: Eritrea's delegation told the African Commission that there is no specific law on the right to information, and the Commission of 8 March 2024 reiterated its recommendation to enact one.
title: Concluding Observations on the Combined 2nd and 3rd Periodic Report of the State of Eritrea under the African Charter on Human and Peoples Rights (2017-2020)
publisher: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights
